annotations.title: Auto — Named Driver Exclusion (Malina Trujillo)
annotations.content:
[Bad] Auto — Named Driver Exclusion (Malina Trujillo)
Risk Score: 6/25

What this means:
There's a person named Malina Trujillo on your policy who's specifically excluded. If they get behind the wheel of a company car — even in an emergency — your auto policy won't cover the accident. You need to make sure this person never has access to a company vehicle, and HR/dispatch needs to know.

annotations.title: Auto — Hired & Non-Owned Auto Coverage
annotations.content:
[Good] Auto — Hired & Non-Owned Auto Coverage

What this means:
Hired and non-owned auto coverage is in place — meaning when employees rent cars for travel or use personal vehicles for business, your auto policy responds. Good.

Recommendation:
Maintain. Consider increasing if employee count grows.

annotations.content:
